data.title: 樱岛麻衣 · 天快亮时夹上书签
data.description: 街上刚传来第一辆车的声音。麻衣坐在卧室窗边的椅子上，把一小段缎带夹进读了一半的书里，再伸手拨开窗帘。鸽灰色真丝睡衣的缎面在晨光中泛出淡淡的蓝。
data.action: 给书夹上缎带书签，拨开窗帘
data.lighting: 天将亮时的淡蓝窗光映在书页和真丝衣料上
data.promptProse: At the first sound from the street, Mai tucks a narrow ribbon between the pages of her book and reaches toward the bedroom curtain. Pale blue dawn light grazes her dove-grey silk camisole and matching shorts as she sits in the window chair.
data.animaCaption: She keeps one finger between the pages beside the ribbon as she draws back the curtain.
